name: Medicine shortages
summary: Chemotherapy drug shortages persist after a Pfizer plant flood
state: ASHP added cytarabine (7 Oct) and irinotecan (12 Oct) injections to its US shortage list, linking part of the rise to flooding at a Pfizer plant in India, a disruption Pfizer expects to last into 2028 (Becker's, 26 Oct). In a September survey every cancer centre reported a shortage and 7% said they could not continue some treatment.
for_you: Patients should follow advice from their clinician or pharmacist; the NHS manages UK shortages through Serious Shortage Protocols.
rubric_hit: Essential medicine shortage affecting major health systems

sources.title: Becker's Hospital Review — The 2026 chemo shortage: a timeline

why: Shipping disruption, factory failures and export curbs can leave essential medicines short, as with US IV fluids after Hurricane Helene in 2024.
drivers: Manufacturing concentrated in India and China, shipping, raw materials, demand spikes, regulation.

rubric.alert: Shortages forcing widespread rationing or cancelled treatment across major health systems.
rubric.watch: A shortage of an essential medicine or supply across several countries, or a UK Serious Shortage Protocol for a widely used medicine.
rubric.normal: No widespread shortages of essential medicines in major health systems.
